hits.asked: Sochiye, vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing lagani ho—fencing kis jagah lagegi: andar ya boundary par? Hear
hits.reply: Bilkul, 160 m rectangle ki boundary ka perimeter hai. Length aur breadth ki chaar sides jodiye: 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30. Total kitna aaya?

steps: Aapko rectangles pasand hain ya squares? Hear → hook
